paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: Length extrapolation results on EgoSchema dataset.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the accuracy percentage as a function of the number of frames across four different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" with a linear scale that ranges from 10 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" also with a linear scale ranging from 40 to 54, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The plot includes four lines: a blue line with circular markers representing "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" starts at approximately 53% at 5 frames, peaks near 54% around 20 frames, and then levels off slightly below 54% by 65 frames. A green line with circular markers representing "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" begins at just below blue at 10 frames and increases bit sharp initially, and slightly till it ends up slightly above blue at 65 frames. An orange line with square markers representing "PLLaVA (DP 8)" begins at about 46% at 5 frames and steadily declines to around 39 at 60 frames. A red line with square markers representing "PLLaVA (DP 16)" starts at approximately 45% at 15 frames and decreases gradually to about 42% by 60 frames. A legend is given right center, describing the lines and color.
